translations.web: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
translations.bsb: A foolish scheme is sin, and a mocker is detestable to men.
translations.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
translations.asv: The thought of foolishness is sin; And the scoffer is an abomination to men.
